description: Test file for the helper function 'filter_out_litellm_params' in the litellm.utils module. It contains a unit test that verifies the function removes internal parameters while keeping provider-specific parameters.

methods.name: test_filter_out_litellm_params()
methods.description: Unit test that checks 'filter_out_litellm_params' removes internal parameters such as 'shared_session', 'metadata', 'litellm_trace_id', 'proxy_server_request', and 'secret_fields', while retaining provider-specific params like 'query', 'max_results', and 'custom_param'.
